name: Edge Case — Invalid Mobile Number Three Times (Escalation)
goal: Verify bot handles three consecutive invalid mobile number entries with escalation message.
constraints: User enters invalid mobile number three times. All other steps are skipped.

testdata.expected_escalation: I'm unable to process your request at the moment. For assistance, please reach out to your location admin SPOC or write to: reenajames@royalenfield.com.

phases.description: User is eligible and proceeds to mobile number entry.
User enters three invalid mobile numbers.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot re-prompts after each invalid entry, after third invalid shows escalation message and ends.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
